# DatePicker

DatePicker retains the browser's native date input. External `aria-describedby` IDs are merged with helper/error guidance; explicit error state cannot be hidden by `aria-invalid={false}`. The decorative icon follows the module's text direction.

- **Import:** `import { DatePicker } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-datepicker--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { DatePicker, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function DatePickerExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-80">
        <DatePicker label="Start date" helperText="Use local calendar dates." />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## DatePicker

It forwards its ref to `HTMLInputElement`. Its props are `DatePickerProps`, which extends `Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "type">`.

- `description`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `error`: `boolean | string`, optional.
- `helperText`: `string`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `status`: `InputStatus`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `wrapperClassName`: `string`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### InputStatus

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type InputStatus = "default" | "error" | "warning" | "success";
```
